description: This Java class implements a retry timeout strategy with exponential backoff, doubling the timeout until a maximum limit is reached. It is used to manage retry attempts with increasingly longer timeouts.

classes.name: DuplicationRetryTimeoutStrategy
classes.description: A final class that implements RetryTimeoutStrategy, managing exponential backoff for retry timeouts with configurable min and max durations.

methods.name: fromConfig
methods.description: Creates an instance of DuplicationRetryTimeoutStrategy from a TimeoutConfig object.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the current timeout to the minimum timeout and resets the try count.

methods.name: getNextTimeout
methods.description: Returns the current timeout value and then increases it for the next call.

methods.name: getCurrentTries
methods.description: Returns the number of retry attempts made so far.

methods.name: increase
methods.description: Doubles the current timeout value up to the maximum limit and increments the attempt counter.
